name: The Kobeissi Letter
zh_summary: The number of restaurants in New York dropped about 2,000 YoY in Q1 2026, the largest YoY decline in at least 36 years, surpassing the 2020 pandemic contraction. Eating and drinking places declined YoY for 4 consecutive quarters. Surging costs including insurance, wages, interest rates, utilities and health coverage are crushing New York restaurants.
en_summary: The number of restaurants in New York dropped about 2,000 YoY in Q1 2026, the largest YoY decline in at least 36 years, surpassing the 2020 pandemic contraction. Eating and drinking places declined YoY for 4 consecutive quarters. Surging costs including insurance, wages, interest rates, utilities and health coverage are crushing New York restaurants.
text:
BREAKING: The number of restaurants in New York dropped ~2,000 YoY in Q1 2026, posting its largest YoY decline in at least 36 years.

This surpasses even the worst contraction recorded in any quarter during the 2020 pandemic.

The number of eating and drinking places in New York State has now declined YoY for 4 consecutive quarters, its longest streak since 2021.

This comes as restaurants are facing surging operating expenses, including insurance premiums, wages, interest rates, utilities, and health coverage, with overall costs rising faster than national averages.

Last year, employee health insurance costs jumped +12.9% for New York-area service firms, business insurance rose +7.0%, while utility costs surged +8.5%, according to the Manhattan Chamber of Commerce.

Skyrocketing costs are crushing New York restaurants.

Skyrocketing costs are crushing New York restaurants.

name: Sawyer Merritt
zh_summary: @SawyerMerritt: the new Tesla Roadster's patented fan and suction system deploys skirts under the battery pack, pulling the car down at ~2G while handling road bumps. $TSLA
en_summary: @SawyerMerritt: the new Tesla Roadster's patented fan and suction system deploys skirts under the battery pack, pulling the car down at ~2G while handling road bumps. $TSLA
text:
This is the new Tesla Roadster's fan and suction system, which the company filed a patent for in April 2025.

Sides skirts and front and rear skirts deploy under the battery pack, sucking the car down at ~2G. Because the skirts can move, they have some compliance, so they can deal with road bumps, road debris, etc. As the speed of the Roadster increases, the front and rear skirts retract to allow for air-flow (venturi effect) under the vehicle.

Tesla: "Our multi-mode fan and ground sealing system acts as a downforce generator, pulling air out from beneath the vehicle. This provides enough suction to hold the vehicle upside down, even when stationary. Powered fans and active wings maximize traction and cornering speeds in all conditions, achieving massive downforce at zero speed."

In their patent, Tesla said: "In the first mode, a complete set of skirts creates a fully sealed bounded region under the vehicle with central fans generating maximum downforce at low speeds on smooth surfaces. In the second mode, a subset of skirts (primarily side skirts) modifies the bounded region while all fans operate to provide downforce in dynamic driving conditions with uneven surfaces. The system includes a control mechanism to selectively deploy skirts and operate fans based on driving conditions, optimizing between maximum downforce at low speeds and improved performance over varying terrain at higher speeds."
